summary: Figma Education offers free Professional features to verified high-school/higher-ed students for one year and educators for two years; approved bootcamp/online-course students receive six months. Higher-ed applicants use SheerID; bootcamp students and educators are verified by the approved program administrator, not self-verification. AI tools including Figma Make and Figma Sites are only available to higher-ed/bootcamp users, not K-12/high-school users. Eligible Education users receive 3,000 AI credits per person each month, with no rollover and a stop at the limit. Each eligible user can publish one Site file they created; custom domains are unavailable. Education eligibility may require reverification and region/school-email checks.
claim_steps: Create a Figma account using the school-issued email; review age-of-consent and regional eligibility.

At https://www.figma.com/education/apply, high-school applicants select High school; higher-ed applicants select Higher ed and complete SheerID. Bootcamp/online-course students and educators ask the approved program administrator to verify them; they cannot self-verify.
After approval, create, upgrade or join an Education team. AI/Make/Sites access applies only to higher-ed/bootcamp users, and monthly AI credits are per person and do not roll over.
Reverify when the stated education term ends if still eligible; K-12 use with students follows the separate school/district application.
